title: Hook doors keep a site label inside /srv/tracy: a label that climbs out or a site entry linked outside is refused
steps: S1: In the TCH checkout with python3 on PATH, run run.cmd (no database, no stand: each hook file is served from a temp folder with SITES_ROOT moved there).
S2: Confirm every test named in run.tests reports ok.
expect: Both tracy-hooks.do.py and tracy-hooks.contabo.py answer /agent-token with 400 'bad label' and core-manifest-write with 400 'refused label' for '../outside', 'good-site/../../outside' and 'good-site\n'; no token from outside is returned and no core-manifest.json is written outside.

With sites/site-a linked to a folder outside the root, both doors refuse 'site-a' the same way; with the sites root itself reached through a link, 'good-site' still returns its token and gets its manifest.
contabo /go-live answers 400 'refused label' for '../outside' and 404 'no such site' for a well-formed label with no folder.
fence: site_dir() in both hook files: one plain folder name, realpath of root and candidate, containment checked

tests: tracy-hooks.do.py: a label is one folder inside /srv/tracy, never a way out of it
tracy-hooks.contabo.py: a label is one folder inside /srv/tracy, never a way out of it
tracy-hooks.do.py: a site entry that links outside the root is refused; a root reached through a link still works
tracy-hooks.contabo.py: a site entry that links outside the root is refused; a root reached through a link still works
tracy-hooks.contabo.py: /go-live refuses a label that climbs out before asking whether the site exists
